about: Fiducial-marker spectra read from Balinovic, Albrecht & Endesfelder 2019 (balinovic2019, CC BY 3.0), figures 2a-6a: normalised excitation (solid) and emission (dotted) of each marker, measured on a Jasco FP-8500 spectrofluorometer (no numbers published). Read by eye on calibrated grid overlays of the high-resolution figures (tools/fiducial_spectra/README.md); points are [nm, % of the peak], about +-1 nm and +-2 % of the peak. A linear plot cannot resolve the tails the paper's quoted efficiencies depend on (0.1-1 %), so a curve may carry a 'tail': exponential below its first point, v(nm) = v0 exp(-(nm0 - nm) / decayNm) from [nm0, v0], its decay fitted by tools/fiducial_spectra/fit_tails.mjs to the quoted value it names ('fitTo'). Resampled on the 300-900 nm grid by tools/gen_dye_library.mjs as spectra 'cs:<id>'.

goldEx.notes: Gold nanoparticles (100 nm, Sigma-Aldrich): 56 % at 561 nm (quoted). The narrow peak (FWHM ~8 nm) looks like the fluorometer's elastic-scatter line rather than the particles' broad plasmon band (Mie: gold_mie.json); taken as published.

goldEm.notes: Gold nanoparticles: 70 % of the emission in ET610/75 (572.5-647.5 nm, quoted).

tetraSpeckOrangeEx.notes: TetraSpeck (100 nm, ThermoFisher) orange dye (560/580): 98 % at 561 nm (quoted). Scanned 500-590 nm only.

tetraSpeckOrangeEm.notes: TetraSpeck orange dye: 85 % of the emission in ET610/75 (quoted).

darkRedEx.notes: Dark red FluoSpheres (200 nm, ThermoFisher, 660/680): 1 % at 561 nm (quoted). Scanned 550-690 nm.

darkRedEm.notes: Dark red FluoSpheres: 2 / 0.7 / 0.1 % of the emission in ET610/75, ET605/70, ET595/50 (quoted).

infraredEx.notes: Infrared FluoSpheres (100 nm, ThermoFisher, 715/755): 0.1 % at 640 nm (quoted). The figure's caption calls this panel 5a; it is the lower half of panel b.

infraredEm.notes: Infrared FluoSpheres: 0.2 % of the emission in BrightLine HC 676/29 (661.5-690.5 nm, quoted).

nanodiamondEx.notes: Red nanodiamonds (100 nm, Adamas, carboxylated): 0.5 % at 561 nm (quoted). The narrow peaks are as measured (NV centres emit broadly, 600-800 nm); taken as published.

nanodiamondEm.notes: Red nanodiamonds: 0.3 % of the emission in ET610/75 (quoted).

quoted.about: The paper's efficiencies (balinovic2019, figure panels a and text): excitation = the normalised excitation spectrum at the laser line; emission = the fraction of the emission spectrum inside the ideal band of the filter (centre +- width / 2). The ET610/75 band is taken as the figures draw it (grey box 568.5-642.5 nm in figs 2a, 3a, 4a, 6a; nominal 572.5-647.5): the quoted 70 % (gold) and 85 % (TetraSpeck) need its blue edge. HC 676/29 likewise as drawn (660-688 nm, fig. 5b). ET605/70 and ET595/50 (fig. 4a, under the same grey) nominal.
